title: Externally observable structured evidence families for hypothesis reduction
question: At M=512, does any predefined externally observable structured evidence channel provide higher one-step hypothesis information efficiency than a scalar output channel, without target identity or evaluator-only information?
hypothesis: At least one externally observable structured evidence family can improve one-step deterministic hypothesis information per environment execution cost over a single scalar output, while preserving target-blind probe selection.

arms.name: scalar_output
arms.intervention: one input row -> one binary output

arms.name: paired_output
arms.intervention: one input row plus one fixed single-bit counterfactual perturbation -> ordered pair of binary outputs

arms.name: quad_output
arms.intervention: four fixed one-bit-neighborhood input rows -> four binary outputs

arms.name: activation_trace_ceiling
arms.intervention: one input row -> ordered six-bit non-input activation trace from an instrumented sandbox

primary_endpoint.name: max_external_minus_scalar_information_per_environment_work_m512
primary_endpoint.definition: max over the three predefined external channels of the five-seed mean of [channel task-mean information_per_work minus scalar task-mean information_per_work] at M=512
primary_endpoint.uncertainty: seed-bootstrap 95% CI, recomputing the max-over-arm statistic inside every bootstrap resample

held_constant: same 512-program static evaluation library per seed
same train/evaluation structure and truth-table disjointness

fixed_counterfactual.paired_rule: base row x and x xor delta
fixed_counterfactual.quad_rule: x xor e0, x xor e1, x xor e2, x xor e3; fixed before measurement

cost_model.candidate_side_work: reported separately and amortized over the registered 160 tasks per seed

information_definition.prior: uniform over the current candidate set
information_definition.mutual_information: H(E_a) because evidence is deterministic conditional on candidate
information_definition.information_per_work: mutual information bits / environment acquisition work

verified_utility_definition.procedure: After a target-blind action is selected and realized target evidence is revealed, retain candidates whose predicted evidence exactly matches the target evidence, take the first min(8,bucket_size) under deterministic candidate order, and run exact CASM verification against all verifier rows.

leakage_rules: Probe selection receives candidate-predicted evidence and public candidate structure only.
Target identity and target index are never selector inputs.
Realized target evidence is unavailable until after action selection.
Verifier-only rows and verifier labels are unavailable to selection.
No confirmatory result determines channel definitions, delta, M, or B.
The activation-trace arm is an explicit sandbox ceiling and is not treated as externally deployable.

statistical_rule.per_seed: mean across 32 tasks at M=512 for each arm, then form arm-minus-scalar differences
statistical_rule.primary_statistic: maximum across the three external arm differences
statistical_rule.bootstrap: resample five seeds with replacement and recompute the maximum statistic

decision_rule.condition: Primary max-statistic CI excludes zero on the positive side and the winning arm is externally observable.
decision_rule.licenses: bounded evidence that a predefined external structured channel is more information-efficient than scalar output on the registered finite workload.
decision_rule.does_not_license: learned autonomous probe selection, general active learning superiority, asymptotic scaling, or multimodal competence.

decision_rule.licenses: instrumented internal computational evidence is informative, while external evidence remains limiting.

decision_rule.condition: Raw information increases but verified B=8 utility does not.
decision_rule.licenses: the channel is informative but not sufficient for downstream selective computation under the registered budget.

schedule.note: Exact one-step channel comparison; no learned optimization.
